about: A non-normative profile: interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance. No specification defines the CESR 1.00 count-code table that keripy 1.x uses, or the KERI 1.x field sets of its key events, so every assertion here is level INTEROP, with a basis instead of a clause. Its CESR cases rest on the named implementation's behaviour; its KERI cases give each KERI 1.0 key event the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure gives it, quote the sentence that reading rests on, and are cross-checked against the named implementation. Passing it is never a conformance claim. This file is generated by scripts/regenerate from scenarios/cesr/ and scenarios/keri/ and must not be edited. Fields: name; normative (false); basis (the implementation and commit the expected values come from or are checked against); cases (the case ids, in order).
name: keripy-1x-interop
